- He also wanted to punish Korea for refusing tribute and to secure trade routes. | | **Key Phases** | 1️⃣ **First invasion (July 1592 – March 1593):** Rapid Japanese advances; sieges at Pyongyang, Seoul, and other cities.
2️⃣ **Korean & Ming counterattack (April 1593 – August 1595):** Successful recapture of major territories; naval victories led by Admiral Yi Sun-sin.
